analysis: The PR only modifies docs/developer/test.md, a developer test guide. The visible hunks are a date bump (line 3), a new Gemma routed-expert placement check description (lines 28-33), and test-description text around the Gemma pipeline lanes. There is no runtime code, key handling, attestation logic, wire-protocol change or configuration default change. The test commands in the file all point at isolated or synthetic state, including the SSD test working volume, which uses DARKBLOOM_SSD_TEST_TMPDIR and explicitly states it does not change production cache config or free-space checks. The cache-qualification commands say never to use production cache roots or keys, which is consistent with the T-041 mitigations. The add-on hold and endpoint-resumption test sections make no claim that weakens TB-011 or TB-012; they state that physical Apple behaviour and the signed add-on peer check are not covered by these tests. No threat-model assumption is invalidated. Limits: I saw the later hunks (around lines 1878-2246) only as a truncated patch excerpt, and the head text I was given stops at about line 918, so changes after that point were not reviewed. The new doc references (the routed-expert prior in architecture/inference.md, DistributedInstalledPlan.gemma4PipelineBatchLanes) were not verified against the source. These are documentation-accuracy questions, not security regressions.
